filters.label: Requested from me or my teams

details.label: Next round guidance
details.title: Guidance waiting for the next round: given with no round pending, or kept from a round that did not go out or whose prompt was not seen landing. The next round, Review or Address included, takes it unless you give other guidance

details.label: Review profile
details.title: The review profile layers a round here reads, lowest first; the profile show command lists the files

words.review_requested: review requested, no review on the head
words.review_requested_again: review requested again after your review

views.label: Inbox
views.summary: What nobody has clarified yet; once clarified, a task leaves for good.
views.empty: Inbox zero: everything is clarified.

views.label: Needs me
views.summary: Tasks whose next step is yours: a gate to answer or your own next action.
views.empty: Nothing waits on you.

views.label: Waiting
views.summary: Tasks whose next step is someone else's, grouped by who owes it.
views.empty: Nobody owes you anything.

views.label: Chase
views.summary: Tasks someone else owes whose check date passed with nothing moving: time to nudge.
views.empty: Nothing to chase: nobody is late.
views.when: task.category in ['ready', 'active', 'waiting'] && task.owed_by != 'me' && task.owed_by != '' && !('stalled' in task.link_signals) && task.check_on > timestamp(0) && task.check_on < now && now - task.since_movement < task.check_on

views.label: Fits now
views.summary: Your next steps that take half an hour or less.
views.empty: Nothing of yours fits in half an hour.
views.when: task.owed_by == 'me' && task.category in ['ready', 'active'] && task.prop.size > duration('0s') && task.prop.size <= duration('30m')

views.label: Blocked by me
views.summary: Asks that wait on you, grouped by who asked, the oldest first.
views.empty: Nobody is blocked by you.

views.label: Stalled
views.summary: Tasks waiting too long: a source says they stalled, or their check date passed with nothing moving.
views.empty: Nothing is stalled.
views.when: task.link_signal.stalled || (!('stalled' in task.link_signals) && task.owed_by != 'me' && task.check_on > timestamp(0) && task.check_on < now && now - task.since_movement < task.check_on)

views.label: In loop
views.summary: Tasks an agent is working on right now.
views.empty: No agent is working on anything.

views.label: Approved
views.summary: Work a source says is approved and ready to land.
views.empty: Nothing in Approved right now.

views.label: Snoozed
views.summary: Tasks asleep until a date, an event or a condition.
views.empty: Nothing is snoozed.

views.label: Focus
views.summary: The tasks you marked to focus on.
views.empty: Nothing in focus: mark a task to focus on it.

views.label: Projects
views.summary: Your open projects.
views.empty: No open projects.

views.label: Someday
views.summary: Tasks you might do some day, out of the way until then.
views.empty: Nothing in Someday right now.

views.label: Logbook
views.summary: What you finished, the latest first.
views.empty: Nothing finished yet.

views.label: Done
views.summary: Finished tasks that still hold a workspace on disk, to remove.
views.empty: No finished task holds a workspace.

views.label: Outbox
views.summary: Drafts waiting for your approval, and approved ones still sending or that failed to send.
views.empty: No drafts wait on you.

views.label: Projects to review
views.summary: Projects past their review, or with no next action of yours and not in Someday.
views.empty: Every project has a next action and is reviewed.

views.label: Review
views.summary: The weekly review: walk each step until the lists are clean.
views.empty: Nothing in Review right now.

views.label: Blocked by you
views.summary: Tasks that wait on you: a gate to decide or someone's ask, the longest owed first.
views.empty: Nothing in Blocked by you right now.

views.label: Stalled the longest
views.summary: Open tasks no agent is working on, the longest unmoved first.
views.empty: Nothing in Stalled the longest right now.

views.label: Agent questions
views.summary: Tasks with a question or a post that waits for your answer.
views.empty: Nothing in Agent questions right now.

views.label: Plans to approve
views.summary: Tasks with a plan that waits for your approval.
views.empty: Nothing in Plans to approve right now.

views.label: Drafts to send
views.summary: Tasks with a draft that waits for you to send it.
views.empty: Nothing in Drafts to send right now.

views.label: Steps to review
views.summary: Tasks with a step that waits for your review.
views.empty: Nothing in Steps to review right now.

views.label: Last steps
views.summary: Your tasks whose work only waits for its last step at its source.
views.empty: Nothing in Last steps right now.

views.label: Pick someone
views.summary: Your tasks that wait for you to pick who takes them next.
views.empty: Nothing in Pick someone right now.

views.label: To act on
views.summary: Tasks with a proposal or a request that waits for you to act.
views.empty: Nothing in To act on right now.

lens.copied_grouped: Copied {{.count}} from {{.view}}, grouped by {{.group}}, as YAML.
lens.no_lens: nothing to group or sort here
lens.filter_title: Filter by {{.label}} {{.value}} · Alt+click leaves it out
lens.filter_title_group: Filter by {{.label}} {{.value}} · Shift+click groups by {{.group}} · Alt+click leaves it out
lens.legend_title: The strip on the left of each row is the color of whom it waits on
lens.stale_title: Its plugin is not reporting; this is its last report
lens.unread_title: The oldest message on its links not yet read by the extraction
